subject: Re: Saturday shift
text: Sorry I was late. I read the wrong calendar entry and thought the volunteer shift began at noon, not ten. I arrived as soon as I noticed, but the welcome table was already covered. The manager understood, though I felt awful leaving you alone with the sign-in stack. I muted my phone reminder by accident and missed the alert. I fixed it and added a watch alarm. I owe you two coffees next time we meet. Please ignore the earlier panic message today.
